line: By afternoon, your head quits. Russian doctor Lesgaft wrote that the mind's GROWTH needs the body to grow along with it. He meant schoolchildren. Did you outgrow that?
credit: LESGAFT · GUIDE TO PHYSICAL EDUCATION · 1888, 2ND ED. 1904 (retold)
